Do not write bare facts, normal Prolog clauses, sentence/2, person_member/1, or any other helper predicates. Required forms are exactly: axiom(s2, has_serpent_body(selah)). Preserve not/or/xor/and rather than deleting difficult sentences. Your bare query must be exactly audit_proof_tree({{goal}}, Result), with no ?- and no trailing period. This query asks only for the stated Horn subclaim `{{statement}}`, not for the English question.
